# sassBoilerplate Archive

This repository is a historical copy of the JR Cologne Gulp Starter Kit.

## Canonical upstream project

- Package: @jr-cologne/create-gulp-starter-kit
- Original author: JR Cologne
- Original repository: https://github.com/jr-cologne/gulp-starter-kit
- License: MIT

## Status

This repository is not the canonical source, official issue tracker, or authoritative release channel for the upstream package.

Its dependency versions and build assumptions are old. Compatibility with current Node.js versions is not guaranteed.

Do not publish this repository to npm under the upstream package name. Use the original repository for current documentation, releases, licensing details, and issue reporting.

## Historical capabilities

- Gulp 4
- Sass, SCSS, Less, and Stylus
- Pug
- Babel
- BrowserSync
- CSS and JavaScript minification
- image optimization
- sourcemaps
